name: Euro-Office
description: Euro-Office Document Server is a European-led, open-source fork of ONLYOFFICE Docs with online editors for text documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs, including real-time co-editing. It is not a standalone app: platforms such as Nextcloud or Seafile store the files and open them in its editors.

notes.text: Connect Euro-Office from Nextcloud, Seafile or another integration with http://<IP> and the JWT secret shown by documentserver-jwt-status.sh inside the container.
To try the editors without an integration, run systemctl enable --now ds-example and open http://<IP>/example/. The example has no login, so keep it off on shared networks.
